description: MEMBERS: the Robinhood Chain wallets this member follows: capital (what each can move), record (counts beside the chain's base rate), activity in the window, and the events that fired. Needs a PumpPill membership (Authorization: Bearer <claim>, from pumppill.org/premium) or one x402 payment per call (USDC on Base). Capital is size, not correctness; a rate is never shipped without its denominator. No activity means not seen moving, not gone quiet; sell sizes are floors, never profit.
